name: Tosoh SMD, Inc.
old_description: High purity metals and alloys for the Semiconductor Industry.
about:
Tosoh SMD, Inc. operates from a facility on Gantz Road in Grove City, Ohio. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials, though it operates under the Tosoh corporate umbrella as suggested by the "Tosoh Global" branding and copyright notices.

The company manufactures consumable materials for thin-film deposition, including sputtering targets for semiconductor, flat-panel display, and solar applications. Its product lines cover high-purity aluminum, copper, tantalum, and titanium targets, as well as gas-atomized metal powders specialized for difficult high-purity alloys. Tosoh SMD also produces a portfolio of proprietary chemical precursors—such as RuDER® for ruthenium and ruthenium oxide, Rudense® for area-selective deposition, and a series of Ts- and Si-based precursors—for advanced semiconductor processes.

These materials serve customers in the semiconductor, flat-panel display, solar photovoltaic, and organic light-emitting diode (OLED) industries. The company positions itself as a supplier to manufacturers requiring high-purity consumables for deposition processes, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

Tosoh SMD’s stated mission is to be the preferred global supplier of high-technology consumable materials for thin-film deposition, emphasizing technological and commercial excellence, on-time delivery, supply-chain quality, and continuous improvement.
